title: Generate image thumbnails using QuickLook
summary: Create PNG thumbnail images for a set of files (like JPEGs) using the system's QuickLook engine. This is useful for creating preview images for a gallery or folder.

steps.explain: Use qlmanage with the -t flag to generate thumbnails. Specify the files (e.g., *.jpg), the size (-s), and the output directory.

placeholders.name: FILES
placeholders.description: Pattern or list of files to generate thumbnails for

placeholders.name: SIZE
placeholders.description: Width of the thumbnail in pixels

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_DIR
placeholders.description: Directory where the thumbnails will be saved
